notes.title: [Important] End of Windows 10 Support and System Requirements Update
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45338422/c21267727618e871367c515a66a1b37500f06648.png"]

Thank you for your continued support of Desktop Mate.



Due to the official end of support for Windows 10 on October 14, 2025, we will also be ending our support for Desktop Mate on Windows 10 on the same date.

Accordingly, the system requirements will be updated as of October 14, 2025.



While you will still be able to use Desktop Mate on Windows 10 after the support ends, it will no longer be officially supported. Furthermore, while we will continue to provide support to users who are on Windows 10, we will not be able to address issues that are caused by the operating system itself.



Thank you for your understanding and cooperation.

notes.title: [Ver 1.5.0] Update Notice
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45338422/2b39a131c69ae96dd820220c87d20989c44a3df5.png"]

Thank you for using Desktop Mate!

We're excited to announce the release of Desktop Mate Ver. 1.5.0, an update packed with improvements and bug fixes — all based on your valuable feedback and requests!

Please update to the latest version and enjoy the enhanced experience!


Highlights of This Update

Improvements & Refinements
Purchased characters will now appear at the top of the list for easier access.

You can now start moving a character even when the menu is open.
Bug Fixes
Fixed a problem where characters might move to unexpected positions when changing display arrangements in multi-monitor setups.

Fixed a bug where characters could appear off-screen if the window they were placed on was closed.

Fixed an issue where the character size set previously might not be restored on startup.

Fixed a bug where the character size might not display correctly in the settings screen when set to the minimum.

Fixed a rare issue where the app could close when changing characters.

Fixed a brief display glitch when creating a new alarm.

Fixed a bug where invalid values could sometimes appear when creating a new alarm.



If you encounter any issues or notice anything unusual after the update, please feel free to report it on the Steam Community Forums.

Your feedback continues to shape the future of Desktop Mate — thank you for being a part of it!

notes.title: [Ver 1.4.1] Update Notice
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45338422/2b39a131c69ae96dd820220c87d20989c44a3df5.png"]Thank you for using Desktop Mate!

We’re excited to announce the release of Desktop Mate Ver. 1.4.1, an update packed with new features, improvements, and bug fixes — all based on your valuable feedback and requests!

Please update to the latest version and enjoy the enhanced experience!


Highlights of This Update

New Features & Improvements
Toggle Taskbar Icon Display: A new setting has been added to choose whether the app icon is shown on the taskbar.

If your capture software cannot detect Desktop Mate, or if characters appear on multiple virtual desktops, please try toggling this setting.

Remember Last Character Position: Characters will now appear at the same position where they were last closed when the app is restarted.

Smooth Character Size Animation: Character size changes now transition smoothly instead of changing instantly.

Improved Behavior with Maximized Windows: If a character is sitting on a window that gets maximized, it will now move to the taskbar.

Prevent Sitting on Maximized Windows: Characters will no longer sit on windows that are in a maximized state.

Enhanced Sitting on Sub-Monitors: Characters can now sit at the bottom of sub-monitors, even if no taskbar is present.
Bug Fixes
Display Issue on High-Resolution Monitors:Fixed an issue where characters appeared to sink into the screen during alarms on 4K and other high-resolution monitors.

Character Size Display Bug:Resolved a bug where, in some environments, restarting with the character size set to 1 caused an incorrect size value to be displayed.
Other Changes
Steam Remote Play Disabled: The app will now automatically close if Steam Remote Play is detected. (Remote Play is not supported.)



If you encounter any issues or notice anything unusual after the update, please feel free to report it on the Steam Community Forums.

Your feedback continues to shape the future of Desktop Mate — thank you for being a part of it!

notes.title: [Ver 1.4.0] Update Notice
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45338422/2b39a131c69ae96dd820220c87d20989c44a3df5.png"]

Thanks for all your support and for using "Desktop Mate"!

We've just released Desktop Mate Ver. 1.4.0, packed with new features, improvements, and bug fixes, all based on your valuable feedback. Make sure to update and dive into a fresh experience!


What's New in This Update

New Features & Improvements
Added Task Tray Minimization: You can now minimize the application to the task tray. This will prevent it from appearing in the taskbar or during Alt+Tab task switching.

Improved Character Grab Detection: The detection range for grabbing characters has been adjusted, making it easier to transition to a "dangling by hand" state when picked up.
Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue where the character would briefly flicker when grabbed while standing. (We are continuing to work on a fix for flickering when seated.)

Improved an issue where the character's coordinates would shift when moved between displays with different scaling percentages.

Fixed an issue where abnormal character coordinates would occur if the character was made to sit on the window when the window and taskbar were in close proximity.

Fixed an issue where the mouse cursor and character position would desynchronize when the character was moved to the edge of the screen while seated.

Fixed an issue where abnormal character coordinates would occur when the character was grabbed immediately after the application launched.

Modified the behavior so that the character's coordinates are less likely to shift when grabbing and releasing the character.

Improved an issue where character rendering would be unstable when the character was placed exactly on the display boundary in a multi-display environment.



If you encounter any issues or have feedback after updating, please don't hesitate to report them on the Steam forum. Your voice is truly the driving force behind our ongoing development!

Thanks for your continued support of "Desktop Mate"!

notes.title: [Ver 1.3.0] Update Notice
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45338422/2b39a131c69ae96dd820220c87d20989c44a3df5.png"]Thanks for all your support and for using "Desktop Mate"!

We've just released Desktop Mate Ver. 1.3.0, packed with new features, improvements, and bug fixes, all based on your valuable feedback. Make sure to update and dive into a fresh experience!


What's New in This Update

New Features & Improvements
Added an option to auto-start Desktop Mate when your PC boots up.

Selecting an unpurchased character now automatically takes you to its store page.

Alarm voice volume now properly references your "Voice Volume" setting.

You can now interrupt alarms midway.

Character motion transitions have been smoothed out for a more fluid feel.

Characters will no longer lie down if their position causes them to be partially cut off at the edge of the screen.
Existing Character Updates
Motions and expressions for existing characters have been refined, and their effects adjusted.

Added new standing and sitting motions for characters.
Bug Fixes
Characters no longer jump when an alarm sounds while they're hidden at the edge of the screen.

Fixed an issue where characters were unintentionally petted when the mouse was placed over their heads.

Addressed a bug where Aieru-tan's wrist would unnaturally twist upon her appearance.

Resolved an issue where Aieru-tan would clip into the display during alarms when using vertically stacked monitors.

Fixed clipping issues with Hatsune Miku's tie, her hair penetrating her face, and her sleeves clipping during alarms.

Corrected the behavior of SNOW MIKU's hair.

Fixed a bug where the arrow buttons on the menu UI scrollbar weren't functional.

Resolved a rare bug where the app would crash if character selection buttons were rapidly clicked.

Fixed an issue where character size could fluctuate from the previously set size upon app launch.

Addressed a bug where forcing the app to close during an alarm would cause abnormal character size on the next launch.



Our development team has put a lot of effort into this update, taking all your feedback seriously to deliver a better app experience.

If you encounter any issues or have feedback after updating, please don't hesitate to report them on the Steam forum. Your voice is truly the driving force behind our ongoing development!

We know many of you have been asking for voice additions for existing characters like Hatsune Miku. We're excited to announce that recording is complete, and we're actively working on implementing these. It'll take a little more time before release, but we're doing our best to get them to you as soon as possible, so please look forward to it!

Furthermore, development has already begun on the "VRM file import function." This is a significant feature that will require a considerable development period, but we'll keep you updated on our progress. Please stay tuned!

Thanks for your continued support of "Desktop Mate"!

notes.title: 🎉 Desktop Mate New DLC "Koharu Rikka" Announced for Summer 2025 Release! 🎉
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45338422/92f74c097efcaa1b5da37f1553097a9a6ab00d47.png

🌸 Koharu Rikka Arrives in Desktop Mate! 🌸
Thank you for your continued support of "Desktop Mate"!
We are pleased to announce the Steam release of the new DLC "Koharu Rikka" in the summer of 2025!
The Steam store page is now open!

💡 What is Koharu Rikka?
Koharu Rikka is a character who has libraries for the singing voice synthesis software "Synthesizer V AI / Standard" and the text-to-speech voice synthesis software "CeVIO AI Talk Voice," "VOICEPEAK," and "VoiSona Talk." The character design is by Nari Teshima, and the character voice is provided by Yoshino Aoyama.

🌸 Features of the Desktop Mate Koharu Rikka DLC 🌸


 Includes original recorded voices by Yoshino Aoyama, a popular voice actress known for her work in numerous productions!
 Features two outfits, summer and winter, which can be switched at any time using the character change function!
 "Lakiston" (Koharu Rikka's official mascot) will appear when the alarm goes off to cutely notify you of the time!


https://store.steampowered.com/app/3681420/

Furthermore, DLCs for the related characters "Karin Natsuki" and "Chifuyu Hanakuma" are also currently in development!
We plan to add new characters and feature updates in the future, so please look forward to further information! 🎵

We welcome your opinions and feedback!
Thank you for your continued support of Desktop Mate! ✨

notes.title: [Ver 1.2.1] Update Notice
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45338422/2b39a131c69ae96dd820220c87d20989c44a3df5.png

Thank you for your continued use of "Desktop Mate"!
Based on your feedback, we have released an update for "Desktop Mate."
The main changes are as follows:

Update Changes

 Reduced CPU Processing Load: Optimized CPU processing load to make the application run more smoothly.
 Corrected Alarm Time Display: Changed the alarm time display to a more user-friendly 12-hour format with AM/PM.
 Fixed Malfunction in Hidden Windows: Corrected an issue where the character would unintentionally sit on hidden windows in virtual desktop environments, etc.
 Fixed Conflicts with Overlay Features: Resolved a bug where the character would become unable to sit while using overlay features in other applications.
 Improved Coexistence with Mouse Cursor Lock Applications: Enhanced compatibility to allow simultaneous use with applications that lock the mouse cursor, such as games.

Price Reduction in Some Regions

 We have reviewed the price balance in each region and adjusted the DLC prices in some areas based on Japanese Yen and US Dollar.


If you encounter any bugs or have any concerns after the update, please report them via the Steam forum. We value your feedback.
Thank you for your continued support of "Desktop Mate"!

notes.title: [Ver 1.2.0] Update Notice
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45338422/2b39a131c69ae96dd820220c87d20989c44a3df5.png

Thank you for using "Desktop Mate"!
This update includes the following bug fixes and feature enhancements:

Character behavior has been updated based on user feedback

 Characters now remain seated on windows until fully hidden
 Automatically adjusts to prevent characters from moving below the taskbar
 If a character unintentionally goes off-screen, they will return to the default position after a short time
 Characters will stay at their current position after switching or triggering alarms
 Fixed rendering issues when changing characters or triggering alarms while hiding at the screen edge
 Fixed a rare issue where characters would hide near display borders


Anti-Aliasing Setting Added to Settings Menu

 If you are experiencing a black background, try adjusting the anti-aliasing setting in the settings menu.


More Detailed Sound Settings

 Added "Voice Volume" and "Alarm Volume" to the settings menu. The previous "Volume" setting has been moved to "Alarm Volume".


Better Support for High-Resolution Displays

 The app now reflects Windows "Display Scale" settings and automatically adjusts the display size (improved 4K support).


We will continue improving the app based on your feedback.
Thank you again for supporting "Desktop Mate"!

notes.title: Announcement of Desktop Mate's Official Release
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45338422/c21267727618e871367c515a66a1b37500f06648.png
Hello everyone!

Thank you for waiting!  
As of today, January 8, 2025, at 12:00 PM, the Windows desktop mascot platform "Desktop Mate" is officially released on Steam!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ov90HqYjUaA

"Desktop Mate" is an application that provides a new experience where characters freely move around on your PC desktop, making it feel like they’re spending time with you. In addition to the default official character "AI Elle-tan," the first additional DLC character, "Hatsune Miku," is also available starting today!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3301060/Desktop_Mate/

【Main Features】

 Real-time 3D character display
 A variety of actions such as sitting on windows or jumping
 Interactive communication using mouse operations
 Handy alarm functionality


【Details of Hatsune Miku DLC】
The globally popular virtual singer "Hatsune Miku" freely moves around on your desktop, offering a close and personal experience as if she’s right there with you.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3359730/

Don't miss this opportunity to experience a new way of life with your desktop!
